review: Independently read project guidance, live issue19 and shared issue8; both are OPEN and issue19 includes the ordinary text-warning amendment. Read the whole combined base-to-candidate source/changelog/test-registration diff and the f49-to-candidate amendment, rather than carrying historical approval.

Existing bool FeatureFilter entrypoints remain; additive value receivers clear and own output with lexical TLS save/restore. Detailed first-origin predicates preserve known identifiers/values and numeric unknown IDs. Malformed shader inputs remain Parse and native OOM remains Create. One grouping defect is recorded separately.

Parser dependency capture owns scalar source identities; queued shader/static/base/library consumers retain exact tags/hashes. FOZ fixtures exercise actual parse, scheduling, lazy resolution and creation, asserting originating categories and zero blocked consumer creation. Operational resource caches remain separate from bounded diagnostic samples.

Warning storage is fixed at 32 groups, 8 global and 2-per-group examples, 64 source contexts; counters/overflow saturate explicitly, resource counts are attempt observations including repeats, and unavailable origin context remains unknown. Keys omit object/parent hashes and changing values, but same-resource nested flags lack sufficient predicate context.

Detailed replay filter calls suppress replaced unsupported logs; private parser captures suppress replaced missing/invalid-resource prose. Bare/generic parse, malformed shader, OOM and ordinary bool/non-replay diagnostics retain output. No global verbosity switch or support-policy change was found. Actual normal-log fixtures capture complete stderr and stdout protocol controls.

finish_events and destructor serialize ordinary finalization, drain/join producers before warning finish, and share a once-only collector flag even without an event writer. Empty/success-only and hard-exit controls cover no-noise/no-completion boundaries; signal/crash paths do not acquire warning locks.

Original source graph/count/identity assertions remain; changed original prose expectations assert replacement parent identity. New Release-active registered warning cases cover 100000 setup rejections, 4096 FOZ fanout, 70 unsupported roots, overflow, saturation, actual queues/memory contexts, lifecycle, CLI/controller/quiet paths and legacy controls. Current grouping test covers resource context across pipeline types but misses attachment versus subpass constraints within render-pass.

CHANGELOG.md has one short Unreleased Observability sentence naming bounded examples/cause counts, practical log-volume/causality benefit and the full issue19 URL. It accurately describes intended delivered scope at this candidate and makes no Windows/GPU/Steam/persistence/global-item claim; no changelog-specific finding.

Manually inspected fresh detached and actual build-source HEAD/clean status, populated submodules, CMakeCache source/options and Ninja effective compile/link bindings. Both independently executed builds were no-work. Debug exceptions OFF uses -g/-fno-exceptions; Release exceptions ON uses -O3/-DNDEBUG, with explicit runtime assertions still active. CLI/layer/SPIR-V validation ON and runtime-layer OFF.

Inspected candidate-bound unit-only raw matrix, sanitizer, compiled mutation logs, their receipts/digests and strict verifier. These were not rerun at final. Unit-only successful commands do not override the new counterexample.

findings.title: Preserve predicate identity for nested render-pass flags
findings.evidence: cli/fossilize_feature_filter.cpp:4874 and :4950 both emit Constraint/flags for attachment-description and subpass-description masks. cli/replay_warnings.hpp:77-89 removes required/available values and keys Constraint context only by resource tag. Actual candidate FeatureFilter calls reject attachment flags=2147483648 against mask7 and subpass flags=2147483648 against mask143; ReplayWarnings combines them into one retained group with two observations and prose render-pass constraint flags. Isolated probe compiles exit0 and runs normal exit1 with FAIL independent/M19-distinct-render-pass-predicate-context; full output/digests in referenced artifact.
findings.required_change: Give these existing predicates distinct stable identities or bounded predicate contexts, and strengthen registered replay-warning-grouping using actual same-resource attachment/subpass detectors. Preserve coalescing of varying requested values within one predicate, fixed bounds and existing decisions.

I independently assessed this as disclosed bounded incomplete detail, not a full-name or distinct-cause cardinality guarantee; coordinator clarified the brief did not add an unchanged-plan full-name-fingerprint requirement.
